messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — PR #11247 is blocked on architecture review. attaching the RFC and the short safety note. cc @arjun @sylvia @helena

morgan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/11247
morgan: RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-09-kv-cache-routing

arjun: thanks — pinged helena in DMs. quick Q: does this change the prefix-KV semantics or just routing?

sylvia: can you also paste the SLO delta here? need to confirm canary won't push p99 over our target. :eyes:

morgan: short summary (for arch eyes):
- change: route slot allocation to prefer hot-key GPUs, adds fallback path to cold pool
- KV semantics: unchanged, still prefix-based caching; we add a routing shim only
- expected perf: ~8-12% lower median latency for hot keys, no p99 regression in perf tests so far
- risk: subtle race on shard leader when moving a key; mitigation: conservative TTL & retry on miss

morgan: SLO delta from local perf runs: p50 -10%, p95 ~0%, p99 +0.3% (within alert thresholds). load test artifacts: https://internal.ci/load/11247

helena: thanks for the links. I can take a look in ~2h. pls attach the lightweight design blurb here (3-5 bullets) and the PR checklist you used.

morgan: pasted the 3-bullets above — PR checklist: unit tests, integration sim for shard move, canary plan, rollback, tagging owner. also added integration test: `tests/shard_move_sim.py`

arjun: note in the PR I left one small comment about a potential double-free in the fallback branch. very minor but want to avoid in canary.

morgan: noted — fixing in a patch now. will push and @helena i'll re-request review when done.

deploy-bot: canary slot available Thu 09:00 UTC if you want to reserve it. Reply `reserve` to claim.

sylvia: if helena can bless this by EOD, can we reserve Thu 09:00 slot? otherwise move to Fri morning.

helena: skimmed the diff quickly — approach ok, main ask: add comment and an assertion around the fallback free to be safe. also include the canary constraints in the PR description (traffic %, time). I'll do a full pass after the patch.

morgan: will add assertion + update PR desc with canary: 1% traffic for 30m then 5% for 1h, auto-rollback on p99 > baseline +1%

arjun: LGTM from infra side pending that assertion fix.

helena: arch bless pending the assertion & updated canary bullets. will re-check in ~30m.

morgan: thanks all — pushing fix now and will re-request review. pinging here when done. :thumbsup:

morgan: pushed patch, re-requested @helena review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/11247/files

helena: quick pass done — looks good, left one nit. arch-approve. feel free to merge during Thu 09:00 UTC canary slot.

sylvia: noted, reserving canary slot now.

deploy-bot: reserved Thu 09:00 UTC for PR #11247. Canary job created: canary-11247-2026-03-26

morgan: awesome, thanks everyone — merging on canary window.
